info.title: FleetIQ HTTP UI baseline
info.description: Backend-owned, versioned subset of the /api/v1 HTTP surface for asset identity, semantic metadata reads, and actor administration. Other implemented routes are intentionally not yet described here. Protected routes use configured workload bearer or provider-neutral OIDC browser sessions. Modes are mutually exclusive; metadata reads check current identity and tenant metadata.read policy. Operator tenant discovery returns advisory current grants without authorizing operations. Actor administration requires exact platform identity.manage and browser mutation protection. Platform-grant administration requires exact platform.access.manage authority. Tenant grant administration requires exact tenant access.manage authority. Semantic definition publication requires exact metadata.manage; bounded catalogues require metadata.read. Asset and communication-device registration require exact metadata.manage and atomically record original actor/time evidence. Relationship and signal-binding revision commands preserve immutable temporal lineage with original actor attribution and exact retry resolution. Protocol artifact registration and isolated policy-versioned admission require separate exact protocol.manage; neither activates a device. Property history and exact interpretation provenance require separately delegated telemetry.read; baseline.16 expands the closed action vocabulary without upgrading grants. Calculator configuration reads require metadata.read and revision/activation writes require separate analytics.manage; baseline.22 expands discovery to six actions without implicit grants.

get.description: Requires fresh exact telemetry.read before discovery; metadata.read or analytics.manage does not imply access. Strict query fields, no-store, at most 1 MiB serialized response, no raw preparation/payload expansion. Half-open event-time range is [start_at_ms,end_at_ms), at most seven days; event time is window end. Cursors bind tenant/asset/range; new backdated appends are not a paging snapshot.

Requires fresh exact telemetry.read before discovery; metadata.read or analytics.manage does not imply access. Strict query fields, no-store, at most 1 MiB serialized response, no raw preparation/payload expansion. Returns retained exact calculator/configuration/input identity without re-evaluation. Outputs are paged separately.

Requires fresh exact telemetry.read before discovery; metadata.read or analytics.manage does not imply access. Strict query fields, no-store, at most 1 MiB serialized response, no raw preparation/payload expansion. Exact evaluation must belong to the tenant and input scope. Cursor binds this evaluation and resource; it cannot be used on another output page.
Requires current metadata.read before resource discovery. Immutable revision creation leaves the active selection unchanged; exact same-author retries preserve original evidence.

put.description: Requires exact analytics.manage, never implied by metadata/protocol grants. Browser mutations require matching Origin and X-FleetIQ-CSRF. Transactionally rechecks current actor, tenant and grant. Immutable revision creation leaves the active selection unchanged; exact same-author retries preserve original evidence.

get.description: Requires current metadata.read before resource discovery. Inactive by default. Selection serializes with enumeration and claims; deactivation pauses unclaimed work, while already issued claims may complete with original evidence. A stale exact retry returns its original receipt without restoring selection.

get.summary: Read bounded observed locations and tenant fleet coverage
get.description: Requires both fresh metadata.read and telemetry.read for the same actor/tenant before mapping discovery. Explicit immutable axis mapping and encoding; no persisted mapping write. Coordinates require distinct source outputs/signals, the same accepted message, decoder release, device, endpoint and device-recorded event time, without repeated signal/timestamp ambiguity. Receipt-only pairing is unavailable. Invalid quality never falls back to older good values. Degrees require numeric deg definitions/source units; E7 requires unitless integer definitions/source values. Full tenant inventory/projection counts and bounded asset rows share a repeatable read snapshot. Unsupported mappings, missing/stale/future/invalid positions and unlocated assets remain explicit. No online/health inference. C-ordered exclusive after cursor; preserve all mapping parameters across pages. SQL statements have 2s deadlines and the read has an 8s total deadline. No last-good fallback or hidden interpolation.

get.summary: Resume authorized latest-state updates for one installed property
get.description: Requires fresh telemetry.read before cursor/scope discovery and again before every emitted data or heartbeat. Uses the durable consistent current projection, not a process-local broadcast buffer. Reconnect cursors bind exact scope and generation/revision; replacements safely coalesce at most 256 forward tenant revisions. Rebuilds, future positions and expired windows terminate with explicit resnapshot. Scope changes need a fresh baseline. There is no historical event replay guarantee, broker or projection write. Browser sessions, identity mappings, actor activation and grants are revalidated, never cached for the connection. Reads have an eight-second deadline; cancellation drops their futures. Connection count is capped at 64 per process and frames/lease/demand are bounded. Already serialized bytes cannot be revoked from network buffers; proxy socket-write/idle deadlines remain deployment responsibilities.

get.summary: Read one exact property's committed current state
get.description: Requires current telemetry.read before parameter validation and metadata discovery. The exact property version must be installed on the asset (otherwise 404). Empty items is a known property without a materialized value. Current precedence is greatest event time, then full immutable interpretation identity in C byte order, with numeric output/binding revision. Quality is preserved, never filtered into last-good semantics. Corrections create interpretations without implicitly retracting other targets. A repeatable-read view pairs value with tenant generation/revision and committed pending-work indication. Eight-second request and two-second statement deadlines fail safely rather than inventing empty state. Freshness is evaluated at server response time, independently of quality.

get.summary: Explore a bounded semantic asset graph
get.description: Requires current metadata.read. Expands both directions of typed relationships and signal bindings breadth-first; directed source/target meaning is preserved. Relationships are considered before bindings per layer, with bytewise identity ordering. Root depth is zero. Latest known revisions are selected before effective-time and endpoint filters, using one repeatable-read snapshot. Included links reference only included assets. Explicit depth/asset/link budgets can omit data; inspect truncation rather than inferring full graph or sensor inventory. Per-statement timeouts and an eight-second graph-operation deadline fail safely rather than returning a misleading partial success.

Requires exact telemetry.read. Returns all interpretations for one pinned property in a half-open event-time window of at most seven days. Ascending event time then full interpretation key provides stable ties, not latest-state precedence. Pages are not a snapshot: restart the window to observe late appends behind the cursor. No raw payload, archival history, correction collapse or implicit unit conversion.

Requires exact telemetry.read. Reads original source, binding revision, exact property version and first-append resolution cutoffs. Corrections do not rewrite this fact. Another tenant/target or absent interpretation yields no provenance; no fallback to current metadata.

get.summary: Inspect bounded device ingestion evidence and observed sources
get.description: Requires current tenant protocol.manage. Uses a consistent database snapshot, at most 64 recent accepted messages and the first 64 decoded outputs per message, then at most 128 distinct source tuples. Coverage flags explicitly describe each truncation. Package references identify the immutable decoder, not current admission or activation; use package/route endpoints for configuration. No raw payload, checkpoint state, telemetry values, external identifiers or credentials are returned. No process/socket heartbeat is collected: worker and connection liveness are explicitly not_observed. Receipt age and pending/leased/expired/poisoned states are operational evidence, not a device-health inference. All outcomes are no-store.

get.summary: Read the latest device/channel protocol configuration
get.description: Requires current tenant protocol.manage. Includes explicit retirement; configuration is not runtime eligibility or peer authentication. All outcomes are no-store.

put.summary: Select or retire an exact admitted device/channel protocol route
put.description: Requires current tenant protocol.manage, a registered communication device and exact stored/current-policy admitted release. Body limit is 4 KiB. expected_revision is a compare-and-swap generation; explicit null selection retires. Same-actor/content retries return the original generation/actor/time even after later edits, without replacing the current head; GET current configuration before further editing. new generations invalidate previous session handoffs even when selecting identical content. Invalid/missing prerequisites return 409; no implicit device creation or artifact activation occurs. Browser commands require exact Origin and X-FleetIQ-CSRF marker. Authentication and authorization precede request diagnostics. All outcomes are no-store.

get.summary: Read an exact stored protocol release
get.description: Returns immutable catalogue identity only when exact bytes are durably stored. Raw bytes are never returned. All outcomes are no-store. Authentication/current tenant protocol.manage precedes resource/body diagnostics. Invalid or inaccessible tenants return 403; metadata.manage does not imply code admission.

put.summary: Register and store an immutable protocol artifact
put.description: Bounded raw upload with host-verified digest/length. Exact retries return 200, first catalogue registration returns 201, collisions return 409. Registration and storage do not admit or activate code. Interrupted storage can leave metadata-only registration; retry identical bytes. Browser commands require exact Origin and X-FleetIQ-CSRF: 1. All outcomes are no-store. Authentication/current tenant protocol.manage precedes resource/body diagnostics. Invalid or inaccessible tenants return 403; metadata.manage does not imply code admission.

409.description: Immutable release identity collision; no overwrite.

413.description: Raw artifact exceeds the 8 MiB ceiling.

post.summary: Admit an exact stored protocol component
post.description: Explicitly checks runtime-v1 or identity-v1 through isolated compilation. Current policy bounds raw bytes to 8 MiB, one compiler per process, 15 seconds wall time, and Linux worker limits of 2 GiB virtual address space and 10 CPU seconds. A failed or interrupted worker creates no receipt. Only Linux admission is supported; unsupported platforms fail closed. Repeated successful admission preserves original actor/time. Does not activate or route devices. Browser commands require exact Origin and X-FleetIQ-CSRF: 1. All outcomes are no-store. Authentication/current tenant protocol.manage precedes resource/body diagnostics. Invalid or inaccessible tenants return 403; metadata.manage does not imply code admission.

422.description: Unsupported WIT or imports; no successful admission recorded.

429.description: The single bounded compiler slot is occupied; explicit retry required.

503.description: Isolated worker unavailable, resource constrained or timed out; no successful admission recorded.

get.description: Requires exact current metadata.read under the listener-selected identity. Returns the existing immutable representation for precisely the requested positive u64 revision, including its original recorded time and half-open effective interval. A missing exact revision returns 404, never another revision. Leading zeros in the decimal path are accepted. All outcomes are no-store. This read does not append, resolve signals or select a bitemporal snapshot.

post.summary: Append or explicitly correct one relationship revision
post.description: Mounted only on an authenticated listener. Requires exact current metadata.manage for the selected active tenant, independent of metadata.read. Browser mode requires one exact configured Origin and X-FleetIQ-CSRF: 1 and never falls back to bearer. Authentication and authorization precede body/reference errors. JSON is limited to 32 KiB with closed nested objects; unknown and duplicate fields are rejected. Actor, tenant, revision identity and recorded time cannot be supplied in JSON. The path selects the exact positive u64 revision as decimal text. Revision 1 creates the lineage; the exact successor explicitly corrects it, without editing old facts. Effective start/end are physical time, separate from trusted host recorded time. Return 201 appended, 200 already_appended for identical complete content with original actor/time, 409 for different content, gaps, exhausted sequence, clock regression or unattributed legacy facts, and 404 for missing same-tenant references. Recorded time cannot decrease. Retry identical identity/revision/content after a lost or ambiguous response, even after later corrections; a commit error is never success. All outcomes are no-store and redact storage details. No deletion, graph-wide cycle/cardinality enforcement or automatic semantic reprocessing is introduced. Directed source and target assets and exact relationship type must exist in the same tenant.

get.description: Requires exact current metadata.read for the selected tenant through the existing listener-selected identity boundary. Returns the existing ordered endpoint representation. No registration or history mutation is performed. Returns 404 if the selected asset has no communication capability. Every outcome is no-store.

post.summary: Attach communication capability and ordered endpoints
post.description: Only mounted on an authenticated listener. Requires exact current metadata.manage for the selected active tenant; no other action implies it. Authenticate and authorize before reporting body/resource errors. Invalid, missing, suspended or inaccessible tenant returns 403. Browser mutations require one exact configured Origin and X-FleetIQ-CSRF: 1; browser mode never falls back to bearer. JSON is limited to 32 KiB with closed nested shapes; unknown and duplicate fields are rejected. Return 201 registered for first creation, 200 already_registered for equal complete content and original registration evidence. Retry the same internal identity and complete content after a lost or ambiguous response; a storage/commit error is never success. Different content or an external-identity collision returns 409 without overwrite. Actor/time are trusted host context, never JSON. Different authorized actors may retry; attribution stays with the first. Existing unattributed strict inserts return 409; no historical provenance is invented. All outcomes are no-store and redact database details. The route asset must already exist in this tenant. Up to 100 endpoints, including an empty declaration. Duplicate endpoint IDs are invalid; complete endpoint ID, kind, name and declaration order participate in retry equality. No protocol activation or semantic binding is performed.

get.description: Only mounted on an authenticated listener. Authenticate and authorize the tenant before reporting command, identity or query errors. An invalid, missing, suspended or inaccessible tenant returns 403. Every outcome is no-store and problems redact credentials and database details. Requires exact current metadata.read; metadata.manage and access.manage do not imply read access. Limit 1..100, default 50. Unknown and duplicate query fields are invalid. Both after_id and after_version are required together. Numeric versions sort numerically within case-sensitive IDs. Cursors are exclusive traversal positions, not snapshots or authority. New versions may be published during traversal; no latest-version alias or distinct-definition total is implied.

post.description: Only mounted on an authenticated listener. Authenticate and authorize the tenant before reporting command, identity or query errors. JSON is limited to 16 KiB; unknown and duplicate fields are rejected. The immutable identity is tenant/kind/ID/version. Versions are positive uint32, need not be contiguous and never replace older meaning. First publication returns 201; an identical complete aggregate returns 200 already_published, including after an uncertain response. Any different name, value kind, canonical unit or ordered supported-property references under an occupied version returns 409. Asset-type membership is capped at 100 and duplicate property IDs are invalid; exact referenced property versions must exist in this tenant. Omitted canonical_unit means null. Failed publication commits no partial aggregate. Publisher identity and receipt time are not part of content equality; this slice does not introduce actor/time audit or backfill provenance for earlier strict inserts.

get.summary: Page one actor's current tenant grants
get.description: Requires fresh authentication and exact current tenant access.manage authority. Other tenant actions, grants in another tenant and all platform actions never substitute. Suspended tenants deny access. Only mounted on an authenticated listener. Every outcome is no-store; problems redact credentials and database details. Authentication and tenant authorization precede validation of actor, command and query input. A tenant that cannot be authorized returns 403. Unknown and duplicate query fields are rejected. Ascending exact action-name order, limit 1..100, default 50. Supply after_action from next_after or omit it. Cursors are traversal positions, not authorization or snapshots; revoked cursor grants need not still exist. Missing actors and actors without grants both return an empty terminal page. Inactive target actors retain grants but cannot use them.

post.summary: Grant or revoke one exact tenant action
post.description: Requires fresh authentication and exact current tenant access.manage authority. Other tenant actions, grants in another tenant and all platform actions never substitute. Suspended tenants deny access. Only mounted on an authenticated listener. Every outcome is no-store; problems redact credentials and database details. Authentication and tenant authorization precede validation of actor, command and query input. A tenant that cannot be authorized returns 403. Browser mutations require one exact configured Origin and X-FleetIQ-CSRF: 1; Authorization cannot bypass browser mode. JSON is limited to 16 KiB and rejects unknown fields. Server derives tenant, administrator and receipt time; clients retain command ID, target, action and kind after uncertain results. IDs are tenant-scoped. Retries preserve first committed time and effect without restoring earlier grant state. Different content or administrator under the same tenant-scoped ID returns 409. Grant/revoke ensures presence/absence; a new already-satisfied command records state_changed false. Missing target actors return 404 with no mutation or audit. An inactive target can retain grants. Existing tenant policy permits self-revocation, including the final tenant administrator; no platform bypass or tenant recovery API is introduced. Self-revocation affects the next decision, so retries may return 403. Previously issued evidence is not recalled.

get.summary: Page immutable tenant access change evidence
get.description: Requires fresh authentication and exact current tenant access.manage authority. Other tenant actions, grants in another tenant and all platform actions never substitute. Suspended tenants deny access. Only mounted on an authenticated listener. Every outcome is no-store; problems redact credentials and database details. Authentication and tenant authorization precede validation of actor, command and query input. A tenant that cannot be authorized returns 403. Unknown and duplicate query fields are rejected. Tenant-scoped history in descending (recorded_at_ms, change_id) order, limit 1..100, default 50. Both before_recorded_at_ms and before_change_id are required together. A cursor is not a snapshot. Initial tenant-provisioning grants have separate evidence: this history alone does not reconstruct current grants.

Requires fresh authenticated actor and exact current platform tenant.lifecycle.manage evidence. Tenant grants or other platform actions do not substitute. Available only on an authenticated listener. All outcomes are no-store with redacted problems. Includes active and suspended tenants; ordered ascending by exact tenant ID. Limit 1..100, default 50. No cross-request snapshot guarantee; unknown query fields are rejected.

post.summary: Provision an tenant with its first external identity
post.description: Requires fresh authenticated actor and exact current platform tenant.provision evidence. Tenant grants or other platform actions do not substitute. Available only on an authenticated listener. All outcomes are no-store with redacted problems. Browser mode additionally requires one exact configured Origin and X-FleetIQ-CSRF: 1; bearer credentials cannot bypass session mode. JSON is bounded to 16 KiB and rejects unknown fields. The client supplies a stable opaque command ID; keep it and all business fields unchanged after an uncertain response. The server derives the administrator and receipt time. Exact retries keep the first committed time and original effect; different content or actor using that ID conflicts. Current authentication and authority are rechecked even on retry. Atomically creates an active tenant, immutable provisioning evidence, and metadata.read, metadata.manage, and access.manage grants for the selected existing internal actor. No grant is implicitly given to the provisioner. Missing administrator returns 404 with complete rollback. Existing inactive actors may receive retained grants but cannot exercise them until active. Replaying provisioning does not restore revoked grants or reactivate a suspended tenant.

post.summary: Activate or suspend an existing tenant
post.description: Requires fresh authenticated actor and exact current platform tenant.lifecycle.manage evidence. Tenant grants or other platform actions do not substitute. Available only on an authenticated listener. All outcomes are no-store with redacted problems. Browser mode additionally requires one exact configured Origin and X-FleetIQ-CSRF: 1; bearer credentials cannot bypass session mode. JSON is bounded to 16 KiB and rejects unknown fields. The client supplies a stable opaque command ID; keep it and all business fields unchanged after an uncertain response. The server derives the administrator and receipt time. Exact retries keep the first committed time and original effect; different content or actor using that ID conflicts. Current authentication and authority are rechecked even on retry. Retains tenant data, grants, and history. Suspension denies fresh tenant authorization and removes the tenant from operator discovery. It does not cancel in-flight work or suspend ingestion/workers. Platform administration remains available for activation. An already-requested state records a no-change audit. Replaying a command after another state transition returns the original effect without undoing the later transition.

get.description: Requires fresh authenticated actor and exact current platform tenant.lifecycle.manage evidence. Tenant grants or other platform actions do not substitute. Available only on an authenticated listener. All outcomes are no-store with redacted problems. Descending (recorded_at_ms, change_id) order. Both before cursor parameters must be supplied together. Limit 1..100, default 50. Each page uses current committed history without a traversal snapshot guarantee. External identity subjects are not returned. Unknown query fields are rejected.

Inactive actors retain grants but cannot use them. No platform-wide grant enumeration.

Browser mutations require one exact configured Origin and X-FleetIQ-CSRF: 1; Authorization cannot bypass browser mode. JSON is limited to 16 KiB and rejects unknown fields. The server derives administrator and receipt time; clients retain command ID, target, action and kind after uncertain results. Removing the final active platform-access administrator conflicts, including when another grant belongs only to an inactive actor. Self-revocation affects the next decision, so retry may return 403: another authorized administrator must inspect audit. Previously issued evidence is not recalled.

Unknown and duplicate query fields are rejected. Platform-wide history in descending (recorded_at_ms, change_id) order, limit 1..100, default 50. Both before_recorded_at_ms and before_change_id are required together. A cursor is not a snapshot. Initial bootstrap grants have separate evidence: this history alone does not reconstruct current grants.

get.summary: Page one actor's current external identities
get.description: Requires fresh authentication and exact current platform identity.manage authority. Tenant grants and other platform actions never substitute. Only mounted on an authenticated listener. Every outcome is no-store; problems redact subjects, credentials, and database details. Authentication and authorization precede input validation. Unknown and duplicate query fields are rejected. Ascending exact (authority_id, subject) order, limit 1..100, default 50. Supply both after_authority_id and after_subject from next_after, or neither. Cursors are traversal positions, not authorization or snapshots; detached cursor mappings need not still exist. Missing actors and actors without mappings both return an empty terminal page. Authorized responses and cursors contain sensitive opaque subjects: exclude request queries, bodies, and responses from routine logs. No platform-wide principal enumeration.

post.summary: Attach or detach one exact external identity
post.description: Requires fresh authentication and exact current platform identity.manage authority. Tenant grants and other platform actions never substitute. Only mounted on an authenticated listener. Every outcome is no-store; problems redact subjects, credentials, and database details. Authentication and authorization precede input validation. Unknown and duplicate query fields are rejected. Browser mutations require one exact configured Origin and X-FleetIQ-CSRF: 1; Authorization cannot bypass browser mode. JSON is limited to 16 KiB and rejects unknown fields. The server derives administrator and receipt time; clients keep the command ID, target, kind, authority, and subject unchanged after an uncertain result. The first committed time and effect survive retries without reapplying an old mapping state. Reusing the ID with different business content or administrator returns 409. Attach/detach is ensure-present/ensure-absent; a new command for an already satisfied state records state_changed false. An identity assigned to another actor conflicts for either operation and is never implicitly rebound. Detach of the actor's final identity conflicts. Missing target actors return 404. Replacement requires attaching a new mapping before explicitly detaching the old. No provider user creation or grant change. Detaching the current login invalidates that session on its next authentication; an uncertain result must be recovered through another registered identity with current authority.

get.description: Requires fresh authentication and exact current platform identity.manage authority. Tenant grants and other platform actions never substitute. Only mounted on an authenticated listener. Every outcome is no-store; problems redact subjects, credentials, and database details. Authentication and authorization precede input validation. Unknown and duplicate query fields are rejected. Platform-wide history in descending (recorded_at_ms, change_id) order, limit 1..100, default 50. Both before_recorded_at_ms and before_change_id are required together. A cursor is not a snapshot. Exact opaque subjects are returned only to the authorized administrator; do not log responses. History does not reconstruct all current mappings because initial bootstrap/provisioning identities have separate evidence.

Requires fresh authenticated actor and exact current platform identity.manage evidence. Tenant grants or other platform actions do not substitute. Available only on an authenticated listener. All outcomes are no-store with redacted problems. Includes active and deactivated actors; ordered ascending by exact actor ID. Limit 1..100, default 50. No cross-request snapshot guarantee; unknown query fields are rejected.

post.summary: Provision an actor with its first external identity
post.description: Requires fresh authenticated actor and exact current platform identity.manage evidence. Tenant grants or other platform actions do not substitute. Available only on an authenticated listener. All outcomes are no-store with redacted problems. Browser mode additionally requires one exact configured Origin and X-FleetIQ-CSRF: 1; bearer credentials cannot bypass session mode. JSON is bounded to 16 KiB and rejects unknown fields. The client supplies a stable opaque command ID; keep it and all business fields unchanged after an uncertain response. The server derives the administrator and receipt time. Exact retries keep the first committed time and original effect; different content or actor using that ID conflicts. Current authentication and authority are rechecked even on retry. Creates the actor, exact authority/subject mapping, and immutable provisioning evidence atomically, without tenant or platform grants. Identity-provider users must already exist; no invitation is sent.

post.summary: Activate or deactivate an existing actor
post.description: Requires fresh authenticated actor and exact current platform identity.manage evidence. Tenant grants or other platform actions do not substitute. Available only on an authenticated listener. All outcomes are no-store with redacted problems. Browser mode additionally requires one exact configured Origin and X-FleetIQ-CSRF: 1; bearer credentials cannot bypass session mode. JSON is bounded to 16 KiB and rejects unknown fields. The client supplies a stable opaque command ID; keep it and all business fields unchanged after an uncertain response. The server derives the administrator and receipt time. Exact retries keep the first committed time and original effect; different content or actor using that ID conflicts. Current authentication and authority are rechecked even on retry. Retains mappings, grants, and history. Deactivation affects subsequent authentication and policy decisions; accepted in-flight work is not cancelled. An already-requested state records a no-change audit. Replaying a command after another state transition returns the original effect without undoing the later transition. Final active identity and platform-access administrators are protected.

get.description: Requires fresh authenticated actor and exact current platform identity.manage evidence. Tenant grants or other platform actions do not substitute. Available only on an authenticated listener. All outcomes are no-store with redacted problems. Descending (recorded_at_ms, change_id) order. Both before cursor parameters must be supplied together. Limit 1..100, default 50. Each page uses current committed history without a traversal snapshot guarantee. External identity subjects are not returned. Unknown query fields are rejected.

get.summary: Discover the caller's currently permitted tenants and actions
get.description: Returns only active tenants with explicit current grants for the authenticated active actor. Actions are advisory UI hints, never authorization evidence; every operation rechecks policy. Platform grants imply no tenant access. Order is ascending tenant ID. Pages observe fresh policy independently, without cross-request snapshot guarantees. Missing or inactive browser identities return 401; no grants returns an empty 200 page. Available only with configured browser or workload authentication.

post.summary: Register an asset and typed external identifiers
post.description: Only mounted on an authenticated listener. Requires exact current metadata.manage for the selected active tenant; no other action implies it. Authenticate and authorize before reporting body/resource errors. Invalid, missing, suspended or inaccessible tenant returns 403. Browser mutations require one exact configured Origin and X-FleetIQ-CSRF: 1; browser mode never falls back to bearer. JSON is limited to 32 KiB with closed nested shapes; unknown and duplicate fields are rejected. Return 201 registered for first creation, 200 already_registered for equal complete content and original registration evidence. Retry the same internal identity and complete content after a lost or ambiguous response; a storage/commit error is never success. Different content or an external-identity collision returns 409 without overwrite. Actor/time are trusted host context, never JSON. Different authorized actors may retry; attribution stays with the first. Existing unattributed strict inserts return 409; no historical provenance is invented. All outcomes are no-store and redact database details. The exact asset-type version must exist in this tenant. Up to 100 external identifiers; omitted authority means null. Kind/authority/value defines each external namespace; identifier declaration order is irrelevant. Duplicate identifiers are invalid. IMEI/serial values never replace internal asset identity.

Only snapshot/replace carry opaque id fields. A healthy demanded stream samples every two seconds, emits unchanged-status heartbeats about every 16 seconds and has a 60-second lease. More than 30 seconds between demands requires resnapshot. No detached producer or buffered change queue exists. Stop/recovery controls close the stream; clients must close native EventSource on terminal events. Browser cookies stay same-origin; never place credentials in URLs. After headers, failures are terminal events rather than HTTP problem responses.

PropertyProvenanceSucceeded.description: Original immutable interpretation and decoded lineage, without raw wire bytes or current-metadata reinterpretation.

IngestionDiagnosticsSucceeded.description: Bounded snapshot of persisted ingestion evidence; no traffic is an empty sample, not an error.

getRelationshipRevision-200.description: Existing exact immutable revision representation; this is not an implicit latest or a current snapshot.

getSignalBindingRevision-200.description: Existing exact immutable revision representation; this is not an implicit latest or a current snapshot.

MetadataRegistrationCreated.description: Complete aggregate, batched children and original actor/time evidence committed atomically.

MetadataRegistrationRepeated.description: Same complete content already exists with evidence; original actor/time is retained.

MetadataRegistrationConflict.description: Internal identity has different content, external identity is owned by another asset, or a legacy object lacks trustworthy attributed evidence. No overwrite.

MetadataRegistrationNotFound.description: The exact asset-type version or underlying device asset is absent in this tenant. Foreign-tenant data never satisfies the reference.

MetadataRegistrationMethodNotAllowed.description: Supported methods are GET, HEAD, POST; Allow order/optional whitespace is immaterial.

Allow.description: Comma-separated supported methods GET, HEAD, POST.

getCommunicationDevice-200.description: Read existing communication capability without modifying endpoint order.

DefinitionPublicationCreated.description: Complete immutable definition committed atomically. No actor/time publication audit is introduced.

DefinitionPublicationRepeated.description: The exact complete immutable content already exists. No additional write or mutation is applied.

DefinitionPublicationConflict.description: This tenant/kind/ID/version already names different immutable content. Changing meaning requires a new positive version.

example.title: Definition version contains different immutable content

DefinitionPublicationNotFound.description: An exact referenced property version is missing in the selected tenant; no part of the publication commits.

DefinitionReadForbidden.description: Missing current metadata.read in the selected active tenant, or the routed tenant cannot be authorized. Other tenant or platform permissions do not substitute.

DefinitionWriteForbidden.description: Missing current metadata.manage in the selected active tenant, tenant cannot be authorized, or browser Origin/CSRF validation failed. Other actions never substitute.

DefinitionCollectionMethodNotAllowed.description: Supported methods are GET, HEAD, POST.

listAssetTypeDefinitions-200.description: Immutable asset-types version summaries ordered by (id, numeric version). Missing identities return an empty terminal page. Complete content is obtained through the existing exact GET.

listPropertyDefinitions-200.description: Immutable properties version summaries ordered by (id, numeric version). Missing identities return an empty terminal page. Complete content is obtained through the existing exact GET.

listRelationshipTypeDefinitions-200.description: Immutable relationship-types version summaries ordered by (id, numeric version). Missing identities return an empty terminal page. Complete content is obtained through the existing exact GET.

listActorTenantGrants-200.description: Current grants in ascending action-name order. Missing actors and actors without grants both return an empty terminal page.

listTenantAccessChanges-200.description: Immutable grant administration evidence, newest first. Initial tenant-provisioning grants have separate evidence.

changeTenantAccess-200.description: Original committed effect. Retries retain first receipt time and never restore earlier grant state.

TenantAccessConflict.description: Tenant-scoped command identity names different content or administrator.

example.title: Command conflicts with current tenant access state

TenantAccessForbidden.description: Missing exact access.manage authority in this active tenant, tenant cannot be authorized, or browser mutation origin/CSRF validation failed. Platform actions never substitute.

listTenants-200.description: Current tenant catalogue ordered by tenant ID; includes suspended tenants.

provisionTenant-200.description: Exact business command already provisioned. Original host receipt time is retained.

provisionTenant-201.description: Tenant, exact initial identity and audit created atomically; no access grants are created.

changeTenantLifecycle-200.description: Command recorded or exactly retried. The original effect is returned without reapplying old state.

listTenantLifecycleChanges-200.description: Immutable lifecycle commands ordered by descending (recorded_at_ms, change_id).

TenantCatalogueMethodNotAllowed.description: Unsupported method for the tenant catalogue.

TenantAuditMethodNotAllowed.description: Only audit GET and HEAD are supported.

TenantAdministrationForbidden.description: Missing the exact operation-specific tenant.provision or tenant.lifecycle.manage platform permission, or failed browser origin/CSRF protection.

TenantAdministrationConflict.description: Command identity or tenant provisioning identity already names different command content.

example.title: Command conflicts with current tenant state

PlatformAccessConflict.description: Command identity names different content or administrator, or revocation would remove the final active platform-access administrator.

example.title: Command conflicts with current platform access state

listPlatformAccessChanges-200.description: Immutable grant administration evidence, newest first. Initial bootstrap grants have separate evidence.

listActorPlatformGrants-200.description: Current grants in ascending action-name order. Missing actors and actors without grants both return an empty terminal page.

changePlatformAccess-200.description: Original committed effect. Retries retain first receipt time and never restore earlier grant state.

listActorExternalIdentities-200.description: Current exact mappings for the selected actor, ordered by authority then subject. Missing actors and actors with no mappings both return an empty terminal page.

changeExternalIdentity-200.description: Original committed command effect; exact retries do not reapply earlier mapping state.

listExternalIdentityChanges-200.description: Immutable platform-wide attach/detach evidence, newest first by receipt time and change ID. Initial bootstrap and provisioning mappings are separate historical facts.

ExternalIdentityConflict.description: Command identity names different content or administrator, the mapping belongs to another actor, or detach would remove the target actor's final external identity.

example.title: Command conflicts with current identity state

listActors-200.description: Current actor catalogue ordered by actor ID; includes deactivated actors.

provisionActor-201.description: Actor, exact initial identity and audit created atomically; no access grants are created.

provisionActor-200.description: Exact business command already provisioned. Original host receipt time is retained.

changeActorLifecycle-200.description: Command recorded or exactly retried. The original effect is returned without reapplying old state.

listActorLifecycleChanges-200.description: Immutable lifecycle commands ordered by descending (recorded_at_ms, change_id).

IdentityConflict.description: Command identity or provisioning identity collides, or deactivation would remove a final active identity or platform-access administrator.

example.title: Command conflicts with current identity state

AdministrationForbidden.description: Missing exact current platform identity.manage authority, or browser mutation origin/CSRF validation failed.

ActorCatalogueMethodNotAllowed.description: Unsupported method for the actor catalogue.

ActorAuditMethodNotAllowed.description: Only audit GET and HEAD are supported.

listOperatorTenants-200.description: Current caller's bounded tenant access hints. No grants is an empty array and null cursor.

getApiVersion-200.description: The active product API major version.

listAssets-200.description: Bounded asset summaries. An empty catalogue returns an empty array and a null cursor.

listAssetRelationships-200.description: Read a bounded relationship snapshot involving one asset

listAssetSignalBindings-200.description: Read a bounded signal-binding snapshot targeting one asset

listSourceSignalBindings-200.description: Read a bounded signal-binding snapshot for one source signal

InvalidRequest.description: Invalid path identifier, definition version, time, limit, cursor, query, or command body.

Unauthenticated.description: The selected authentication mode rejected missing, invalid, expired, or unregistered credentials. WWW-Authenticate is emitted only for configured workload bearer mode.

Forbidden.description: The actor has no current metadata.read grant for this tenant.

NotFound.description: The authorized exact resource or required current asset is absent.

BrowserMethodNotAllowed.description: The method is unsupported for this browser authentication endpoint. Consult Allow for supported methods.

BrowserUnauthenticated.description: The browser credential or login attempt is absent, invalid, expired, or no longer registered. API reads do not redirect to sign-in.

getOperatorSession-200.description: The current authenticated operator session. No provider token, external subject, or tenant grant is returned.

beginOperatorLogin-303.description: A five-minute browser-bound login attempt was persisted. Navigate to the configured provider authorization URL.

Location.description: Configured HTTPS provider authorization URL with code flow, PKCE S256, state, and nonce.

Set-Cookie.description: Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, Path=/ cookies without Domain; callback may emit multiple Set-Cookie fields.

completeOperatorLogin-303.description: A registered operator authenticated. A fresh session replaces the previous credential; the login cookie is cleared.

Location.description: Fixed same-origin destination /, without user-selected return targets.

Set-Cookie.description: Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, Path=/ cookies without Domain; callback may emit multiple Set-Cookie fields.

endOperatorSession-204.description: The session was revoked if present, bound pending login attempts were removed, and both browser cookies were cleared. Logout is idempotent without a session.

cache-control.description: Protected responses are not stored by shared or browser caches.

referrer-policy.description: Authentication responses prevent authorization code or state disclosure through referrers.

bearerAuth.description: Current configured workload credential. A browser-safe identity flow is not available yet.

cookieAuth.name: __Host-fleetiq-session
cookieAuth.description: Opaque Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, host-only session cookie. Available only in configured browser OIDC mode; workload bearer and browser modes are mutually exclusive.
